summary: Iranian forces launched ballistic missiles from multiple provinces targeting US bases in Jordan and UAE, prompting retaliatory US airstrikes in Iraq. Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) conducted operations in Lebanon and Gaza, eliminating Hamas operatives. Regional tensions escalated with gas market volatility and military posturing across the Middle East.
key_points: Iranian forces launched ballistic missiles from Kermanshah Province targeting US bases in Jordan and UAE (Source: @shin_persian/9238).
IDF eliminated Hamas operative Sa'ameh Asama Hamas in Gaza (Source: @almogboker78/18084).
US airstrikes in Iraq targeted Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps positions (Source: @inon_yttach/9980).
Iranian drones targeted US helicopters at Al-Minhad base in UAE (Source: @presstv/204817).
IDF conducted operations in southern Lebanon, targeting Hezbollah positions (Source: @lelotsenzura/94264).
Gas futures rose 2.7% amid tensions in the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387740).
Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed attacks on US bases in Jordan (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79996).

sections.executive_summary: Iranian missile launches from Kermanshah, Shiraz, and Zanjan targeted US bases in Jordan and UAE, triggering US airstrikes in Iraq. Israeli operations in Lebanon and Gaza eliminated Hamas and Hezbollah-linked targets. Regional gas markets surged amid heightened military activity in the Strait of Hormuz.

points: Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps launched ballistic missiles from Kermanshah Province targeting US bases in Jordan (Source: @shin_persian/9238).
Missiles were launched from Shiraz, Fars Province, and Zanjan Province as part of coordinated attacks (Source: @shin_persian/9227, @shin_persian/9232).
IRGC claimed destruction of US technical infrastructure at King Hussein and Blue bases in Jordan (Source: @naya_foriraq/88854).
IRGC stated they targeted US helicopters and forces at Al-Minhad base in UAE with drones (Source: @presstv/204817).
IRGC declared they would give 'a firm response to the aggressor' following US airstrikes in Iraq (Source: @presstv/204813).
IDF eliminated Hamas operative Sa'ameh Asama Hamas in Gaza after he promoted terror attacks against Israeli forces (Source: @almogboker78/18084).

sections.threat_assessment: Iranian missile and drone attacks on US bases in Jordan and UAE represent a significant escalation, with potential for broader regional conflict. Israeli operations in Lebanon and Gaza indicate preparation for multi-front warfare. The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical flashpoint, with energy market implications. US military assets in the region face heightened risk from Iranian asymmetric warfare tactics.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are experiencing direct Iranian military engagement, with UAE and Jordan bases targeted. Hezbollah's positions in Lebanon are under Israeli pressure, raising concerns about spillover conflicts. Iraqi sovereignty is compromised by cross-border military actions. Regional gas markets are destabilized by Hormuz tensions, affecting global energy security.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iranian missile launches from multiple provinces demonstrate coordinated multi-axis attacks. US airstrikes in Iraq suggest direct retaliation against Iranian proxies. Israeli operations in Lebanon and Gaza indicate strategic preparation for extended conflict. Energy market volatility reflects growing uncertainty in maritime trade routes. Intelligence gaps remain regarding Iranian nuclear program developments.
